notes.title: July Playtest Small Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First of all, thank you for helping us test the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and it is already helping us make improvements.



We have just pushed a small patch that addresses some issues we could easily address with a client side patch. If you haven't received the update yet, try restarting Steam to download.



Changelog:

Fixed sniper scopes being off-center when aiming in first-person.

Fixed a bug causing VOIP to break for everyone on the server.

Fixed VOIP defaulting to 2D instead of proximity-based audio.

Reduced screenshake from grenade explosions and other effects. The game should now feel much more playable. (Sorry guys, I have been trying to fix this issue for several playtests now, but only now realized the underlying cause..)

Fixed minor UI issues on the Campaign map.

Fixed missing directional arrows above Call-Ins, which now properly indicate where they are headed.



Secondly, we would love to see your epic or funny gameplay moments! Please share your screenshots and videos here on Discord or on other Social Media. Not only does it help us promote the game, but we would also love to see what you all are experiencing in the game!



And finally, please help us spread the word! Nothing beats word of mouth. If you're enjoying the game, tell your friends, your family, your grandma, your boss, your entire social circle... even the guy standing next to you at the store.



Thanks again!!!
